required_behavior: EnglishContact's WhatsApp click emits exactly one Google conversion to the exact wa_tap destination; its Call click emits exactly one conversion to the distinct exact call_tap destination.

Each existing first-party trackEvent remains first in its click handler with its listingId, surface, and attribution unchanged; each href, target, rel, approved phone, and listing-specific WhatsApp URL remains unchanged.
No Google conversion is emitted during render, page load, or from any Georgian route or component outside EnglishContact.
Dispatch is synchronous and never prevents, delays indefinitely, or takes control of anchor navigation.
Missing or throwing gtag fails safe by returning false and never throws through the click handler.
The Google payload contains only send_to; no value, currency, transaction identifier, listing, phone, href, surface, or other invented data is sent.
All H1 base-tag and denied-by-default Consent Mode artifacts remain byte-identical.
The prior English-agent acceptance and complete unit suites remain green.

required_interfaces.destination_core: lib/google-ads-conversion-core.ts exports googleAdsConversionDestination for wa_tap and call_tap, returning null for every unknown action
required_interfaces.client_sender: lib/google-ads-conversion-client.ts exports synchronous sendGoogleAdsConversion(action, optionalGtagOverride), calls gtag('event','conversion',{send_to}) exactly, and returns false rather than throwing when unavailable
required_interfaces.click_wiring: components/EnglishContact.tsx calls sendGoogleAdsConversion once inside each corresponding existing click handler after trackEvent
